jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 토지이동이력 lane `land-transfer-history` (root ADR-0169 ③): pick the newest vintage whose objects cover every 시도 the lane contract requires, read from the ZIP members measured beside the Bronze ledger, and, unless silver.land_transfer_history already records it or a newer one (`unchanged`), export each object, stage it on a load branch, compare it with the table's current rows key bucket by key bucket and append to main only the changed keys' rows and a removal marker per vanished key (lane contract compare.content_columns; root ADR-0311, ADR-0318), and read it back (`changed`). Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). One lane runs at a time: each takes the compose `spark` cap.
